subject: Consolidated seat exchange and tier swap plan - Novamed renewal
messages:
From: Sofie Harris <sofie.harris@novamed.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidating unused seats into new research tier

Hi Irene,

Quick question as we approach our renewal window — our research group piloted Redwood last quarter but didn’t consume all of their seat allotment. We want to move 120 of those unused seats into a new Research+ tier (different feature set) and grow our overall commitment by ~15% mid-contract. Can you share how you’d handle a seat exchange like this, whether we can get credit for the unused seats, and how pricing for the Research+ tier would align mid-term?

We’re aiming to finalize internal approvals by end of next week. Appreciate a clear path so I can present to procurement.

Thanks,
Sofie
Sofie Harris
Director of AI Ops — Novamed

From: irene.choi@redwood.com
To: Sofie Harris <sofie.harris@novamed.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, Tom Li <tom.li@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating unused seats into new research tier

Hi Sofie — thanks for the heads-up and congrats on the pilot going well. Short answer: yes, we can structure a consolidated seat exchange plus mid-contract uplift with a few options depending on how you want credits, billing, and term alignment handled.

Options I recommend (high level):

1) Seat-swap + pro-rata credit: We convert the 120 unused seats into a time-limited credit applied to the Research+ tier add-on pricing. Credit amount equals the unused remaining term value (pro-rated). This preserves your current renewal cadence.

2) Annualize + swap: We annualize the 120 seats into a new Research+ line and normalize pricing to a single co-term annual renewal. This requires pro-rating the newly created line to your next renewal date (we can annualize to your Oct 1 renewal).

3) Voucher + top-up: Provide a voucher (one-time dollar credit) that covers the seat exchange; Novamed tops up an uplift commitment for capacity predictability. This is useful when internal cost centers need a single invoiced item.

Attached I’m sharing a sample seat mapping and a quick pro-rata calc. If you can confirm which option leans closest to procurement’s preference, I’ll loop in Finance for exact numbers and a DocuSign amendment.

I can also put together a minimal legal-friendly amendment if you want to avoid a full contract redline.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachment: Novamed-seat-mapping.xlsx
From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-15T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: price levers for Research+ (prep for Novamed)

Irene — capturing a few thoughts before we present numbers to Sofie/Tom:

- Research+ is a feature-tiered add-on (50% premium over base seats) but volume bands kick in at 200+ seats. For a 120-seat swap + 15% growth, they’ll cross a band if we include the new commitment.
- For option 1 (seat-swap + pro-rata), finance can calculate an unused-seat credit based on net invoice months remaining. Avoids changing their renewal date.
- For option 2 (annualize), legal typically asks for a short amendment that transitions the 120 seats into a new line with a co-term. Might create a small one-off pro-rate line item.
- Option 3 (voucher) is fastest operationally — we issue a voucher code that appears on their next invoice. Good for procurement that wants a dollar offset.

Question: do we want to offer a 7.5% mid-contract uplift discount for the added capacity if they commit to the increased band (helps close quickly)? I think it’s defensible for a 12–18 month incremental commit.

Irene — I can run numbers if you want; recommend we surface both the full ARR impact and the monthly invoice delta in the proposal.

—Grace
Head of Customer Success (cc for pricing)

From: irene.choi@redwood.com
To: Sofie Harris <sofie.harris@novamed.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, Tom Li <tom.li@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating unused seats into new research tier

Hi Sofie — following up with a recommended path and numbers attached.

Recommendation (quick): go with option 1 (seat-swap + pro-rata credit) and a 12-month commitment on the uplifted capacity that lets you keep the same renewal date. We’ll offer a 7% uplift discount on the incremental seats if you commit to the new total for 12 months. Key benefits: preserves procurement cadence, minimal legal touch, and immediate invoice-level credit.

High-level numbers (estimates):
- Unused seats: 120 -> pro-rated credit: $38,400 (applies to next invoice as a line credit)
- Incremental uplift (15% growth): +180 seats at Research+ pricing -> incremental ARR impact: $312,000 annualized
- One-time paperwork: simple amendment + credit memo; no contract term extension.

If that sounds workable I’ll pull exact finance-calculated credit and route an amendment via DocuSign once Novamed confirms. I’ve attached the pro-rata PDF and a mapping sheet.

Regards,
Irene

Thanks everyone — that all looks good. Procurement prefers Option 1 + the 12-month commitment with the 7% uplift discount. Sofie and I are aligned to sign quickly; please route the DocuSign to me (tom.li@novamed.com).

Appreciate the quick turnaround,
Tom
